description: The tab bar of Record's middle: each open page of notes, chat being read, file's code and the Feedback page is a tab. A closed tab is remembered for next time (pages of the notebook, chats).

parts.name: tab
parts.shows: A tab has an icon, a title, a close ×, and a tooltip. A page of notes: dictionary icon, the page's own short name (a page Work:Plans is titled Plans, tooltip is its full name Work:Plans). A chat: Claude icon, the chat's title, tooltip "{title} · {folder}". A file's code: a script icon, the file's name (with " (note)" for a version of a file), tooltip is its path. Feedback: mail icon, title "Feedback", tooltip "The feedback on Baude, and where each stands". The bar is always shown (it does not hide with one tab).
text: The feedback on Baude, and where each stands

actions.does: Closes it. A chat's reading and a page's timers stop; what is open is kept for the next start; the page left empty and unlinked goes from the pages list.
Reorders tabs (libadwaita tab bar); the order is kept.

parts.name: tab content
parts.shows: Only the tab shown has a size. A page of notes: RecordNotes. A chat: RecordRead. A file's code: Baude's code view, with its own find bar and zoom. Feedback: Baude's Ongoing Feedback page (shared, not described here).

states.name: tab opened again
states.shows: Opening what is open already shows its tab and does not make another. One page, one chat, one file's code (per version) each have one tab.

states.name: notebook switched
states.shows: Switching notebook closes the pages' tabs of the one left and opens the new one's: the ones it had open, its last page shown (Home if none). Chats and code tabs stay.

states.name: browser-like history
states.shows: Each tab shown is remembered, a file's code at each line it was shown at. Back and forward (Alt+Left/Right, Option+Cmd on macOS) show it again, opening the tab again if it was closed, unless it is gone (a deleted page, a chat file removed, another notebook's page).
